tested_sax_parser: defusedxml.expatreader.DefusedExpatParser (defusedxml.sax.make_parser(); subclass of xml.sax.expatreader.ExpatParser; asserted in the image and in the feedback check)
parser_family: untangle SAX ContentHandler over defusedxml 0.7.1 DefusedExpatParser over CPython 3.14 xml.sax.expatreader/pyexpat over Expat 2.10.0; shares the Expat XML parser family with projects/xml/python/xmltodict and the standard xml.etree.ElementTree path
build_note: untangle is installed from the pinned py3-none-any wheel (untangle/ checked byte-identical to the sdist's src/untangle) with defusedxml 0.7.1 by hash. Ubuntu's CPython 3.14 pyexpat loads Expat 2.10.0 built from source with clang LLVM source coverage (same Expat pin as projects/xml/python/xmltodict) through LD_LIBRARY_PATH; pyexpat.EXPAT_VERSION is asserted. untangle 1.3.1's module still reports __version__ = '1.3.0'; the installed distribution is 1.3.1.
api: untangle.parse(pathlib.Path(local XML file)); Element._name, _attributes, cdata and children filled by untangle.Handler from SAX startElement/characters/endElement events
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: Python line tracing of the untangle.parse call (untangle/__init__.py and defusedxml, plus CPython's xml/sax driver reported separately) and LLVM source coverage of source-built Expat 2.10.0 reached through pyexpat
scope: Valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 local files without DOCTYPE through untangle.parse(path-like): raw qualified element names with '-', '.' and ':' replaced by '_' (keywords get a trailing '_'), raw qualified attribute names and values in source order, xmlns/xmlns:* declarations kept as ordinary attributes, per-element concatenated character data (CDATA included), and tree depth. untangle runs the SAX parser with namespace processing off, so it never resolves namespace URIs: element and attribute names carry only the source prefix, and declared URIs appear only as xmlns attribute values. Passing feature_namespaces=True yields an empty tree because untangle.Handler implements startElement but not startElementNS. Comments and processing instructions are not delivered to the handler, and text from mixed content is concatenated per element rather than kept in document order.
namespace_caveat: untangle drops namespace URIs. The adapter does not reconstruct them: element names are lossy (':' becomes '_', indistinguishable from '-', '.' or a literal '_'), so any URI in the summary would be adapter-side namespace processing, not untangle's parse result. Shared fields are therefore compared against the independent lxml/libxml2 oracle projected to untangle's documented naming rule, and the expanded names it loses are recorded in data/python/xml/untangle-valid-feedback.json.
parser_options_caveat: defusedxml's DefusedExpatParser defaults are forbid_dtd=False, forbid_entities=True, forbid_external=True; untangle passes no SAX features here. No DTD, entity or malformed-input behavior was tested.
